properties.description: A non-human, non-agent consumer: GitHub Actions runs tools/reflow2_check.py against the committed export on every push and pull request, and fails the build on unaccepted drift or a broken export chain. It is the only actor that can REFUSE work. It reads only what is COMMITTED, which is exactly why the kit manifest cannot be gated there (fact:defect-kit-manifest-drift-is-invisible-to-ci). Distinct from the driving agent: it never writes, never answers a question, and cannot be asked one.
properties.name: The CI runner
